title.en: A Place in My City That Matters to Me
title.zh: 城市裡對我有意義的地方

subtitle: 寫一個對你有特別意義的地方，以及它為什麼重要
task: Write about a place in your city or town that is important to you. Describe the place, explain how you discovered it, and discuss why it matters to you.
taskZh: 寫一個你所在城市或家鄉中對你很重要的地方：描述這個地方、說明你怎麼發現它，並討論它為什麼對你有意義。
focus: 現在完成式與過去式的正確搭配
說明「為什麼重要」而不只是描述

en: If someone asked me to name my favorite place in Taichung, I would not choose a famous night market or a shopping mall. Instead, I would choose a quiet stretch of riverside path about ten minutes from my apartment. It is not beautiful in a postcard way, but it has become an important part of my life.

I first went there during my second year of high school, when exam pressure was making it hard for me to sleep. One evening, I went for a walk simply to get out of the house, and I discovered that the sound of the water calmed me down. Since then, I have walked there almost every evening. I see the same elderly couple doing exercises, students jogging in pairs, and a man who feeds the stray cats at exactly seven o'clock.

What makes the place special is not what happens there but how it makes me feel. In a city full of traffic and noise, the path gives me space to think. The more stressful my week is, the longer I tend to stay. Walking there reminds me that I do not have to solve every problem at once.

Recently, the city government announced a plan to build a parking lot nearby. I hope the path will be protected, because places like this are rare. A city needs quiet corners as much as it needs new buildings.
zh: 如果有人要我說出在台中最喜歡的地方，我不會選有名的夜市或購物中心，而是會選離我家大約十分鐘、一段安靜的河濱步道。它並不是明信片上那種漂亮，卻已經成為我生活中重要的一部分。
我第一次去那裡是在高二，那時考試壓力讓我很難入睡。有天晚上，我只是想離開家出去走走，結果發現水聲讓我平靜下來。從那時起，我幾乎每天傍晚都去那裡散步。我總會看到同一對老夫妻在做運動、學生兩兩結伴慢跑，還有一位每天準時七點餵流浪貓的先生。
讓這個地方特別的不是那裡發生了什麼，而是它帶給我的感受。在一個充滿車流和噪音的城市裡，這條步道給了我思考的空間。一週壓力越大，我就待得越久。在那裡散步提醒我，不必一次解決所有問題。
最近，市政府宣布要在附近蓋停車場。我希望這條步道能被保留下來，因為這樣的地方很少見。一座城市需要新建築，也同樣需要安靜的角落。
